page_title: FRE 1-1 MAI | Freiburg v Mainz 21/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Marco Fritz is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) is adjudged offside.
86' Here is a change. Anthony Caci is going off and Bo Henriksen gives the last tactical orders to Silvan Widmer (Mainz).
85' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lucas Holer.
85' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) has tested the patience of referee Marco Fritz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
82' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Robin Zentner makes a comfortable save.
77' The total number of attempts is 6:15.
73' Bo Henriksen prepares a substitution. Brajan Gruda is replaced by Karim Onisiwo (Mainz).
71' Anthony Caci (Mainz) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
70' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Fritz had an easy-decision to make.
67' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) loses his marker and gets on the end of the free kick, but he is unable to control the ball properly and balloons his close-range header high over the bar.

66' What a chance that is! Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes high over the crossbar!
63' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) leaps high deep inside the box to meet a beautiful cross from the resultant free kick. He glances a header goalwards, but it's not accurate and goes narrowly over the bar.
62' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tom Krauss (Mainz) was quite harsh and Marco Fritz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
58' Golden chance! Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
56' Christian Streich has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) replacing Christian Gunter.
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) comes onto the pitch for Vincenzo Grifo.
54' Great teamplay by Freiburg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
52' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
49' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
46' Bo Henriksen has made a change at the break. Tom Krauss (Mainz) has come on in place of Leandro Barreiro.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) makes a strong challenge and Marco Fritz blows for a foul.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' The resulting set piece from Mainz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

44' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play. Mainz win a corner kick.
43' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
43' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
42' That's a clear yellow card. Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) goes into the book.
40' 1 - 1 Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the bottom left corner.
39' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
35' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
33' A loose ball is pounced on by Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Noah Atubolu is alert and makes a comfortable save.
31' Marco Fritz shows a yellow card to Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) for his blatant foul.
30' The corner kick from Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

29' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Robin Zentner shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Freiburg have been awarded a corner kick.
25' 36:64 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
21' The corner from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is cleared away by the defence.

20' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.
19' What a great effort! Dominik Kohr (Mainz) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
18' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

17' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger. The ball goes behind for a corner. Mainz will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
17' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player. The referee signals a corner kick to Mainz.
16' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
15' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Freiburg earn a corner.
10' Marco Fritz blows his whistle. Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) commits a foul after dangerous play.
6' 1 - 0 Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) leaps to meet an excellent cross and steers a fantastic header past the goalkeeper, inside the right post.
3' The Mainz players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Mainz will have the kick-off.
Marco Fritz will supervise the game today.
